revision.refused: No changes committed. The proposed smallest-stored-y default, smallest-x tie-break, and removal of admissible-member selection are unsupported across rounds. Round 3 explicitly records choosing the larger-y blue target while the smaller-y green target remained eligible, contradicting a universal robot-near-first priority. Applying the proposed default after placement and in fallback rules does not resolve that contradiction. The memory correctly retains the eligible targets; neither its fields nor its serialization need changing. Retain the existing admissible-member selection rule. Exact recorded-object prediction remains unresolved and requires an independently supported pickup priority or evaluation accepting any eligible remaining target, rather than another convention fitted to one round.
